recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則並互相吻合連結（osteosclerosis），骨小樑之間是纖維化基質與成群的巨核細胞，符合原發性骨髓纖維化相關的骨硬化。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with new bone formation
Clusters of enlarged megakaryocytes within the residual marrow
Dilated sinusoids and reduced normal hematopoiesis
describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae with appositional new bone formation, substantially narrowing the marrow space. The intertrabecular areas contain a fibrotic, streaming stroma with clusters of enlarged megakaryocytes, dilated sinusoids and reduced normal hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with osteomyelosclerosis in the setting of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains are recommended for fibrosis grading.

ddx.vs: Osteoblastic metastases also cause new bone formation but contain cohesive tumor nests that are keratin positive, rather than clustered atypical megakaryocytes.
Renal osteodystrophy shows paratrabecular fibrosis with osteoclastic tunneling resorption and osteoid seams, without MPN megakaryocytic proliferation.
Mastocytosis produces osteosclerosis around paratrabecular spindle mast cell aggregates with eosinophils, identified by tryptase/CD117/CD25.
Paget disease shows a mosaic pattern of cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and lacks megakaryocyte clusters.
